settings_source: SD3.5 Large model card: 28 steps, guidance_scale 3.5. SD3 img2img pipeline default strength 0.6.
pca_protocol: One PCA is fitted on image 1 step-0 spatial latent vectors and reused for every denoising state and for image 2.

sampling_note: SD3.5 uses the VAE posterior MODE (deterministic), then official image-to-image flow scheduler noise mixing with the same seeded noise.
